topic: Mathar's recurrence conjectures for half-factorial binomial transforms and their linked identities
title: Mathar's half-factorial recurrence conjectures: extensions of Jovovic's formulas and Barry's array sums

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Jovovic's generating-function formulas of 25 September 2003 and Barry's array-sum identity (2009, Section 13.2, pp. 283–284), we prove Mathar's recurrence conjectures in the Formula fields of OEIS A081124, revision 8 (24 November 2012), and A084261, revision 9 (30 November 2012), retained in revisions 20 and 29, respectively. A common finite-sum argument proves both recurrences for every n ≥ 3. For the fixed-point polynomials of Fang, Hamaker and Troyka, we also give a parameter-dependent recurrence and self-contained proofs of the continued fractions and Hankel determinants recorded by Hanna and Barry. Further consequences include partial sums and linked factorial-ratio identities.
summary: Both of Mathar's half-factorial binomial-transform recurrences have complete all-index proofs. The note extends Jovovic's formulas and Barry's array identities with weighted recurrences, a formal Jacobi fraction, parameter-independent Hankel determinants and factorial-ratio consequences. An incorrect interval product and its SageMath equivalent in A081125 are corrected explicitly. Prior counting proofs and formula records are credited.
